Mr. Chen chuckled softly. "Indeed it does, Sarah. It’s where we find our own peace amidst chaos."

Their friendship blossomed slowly but surely, each visit bringing them closer together. Through shared books and conversations, they found not just companionship but also a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them.
